steps.content: You are in the temporary base outside the crypt. Using the Legion's communications equipment, you finally get in touch with the MBCC. It has been 47 hours since you lost contact with them.
The MBCC is taken aback by your encounter and analysis. An investigation on the inheritance soon follows, and Nightingale makes rescuing you a priority.
Three hours prior to the agreed meetup time, you step out of the communications vehicle to find Zoya waiting for you outside.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: You done?

options: You're not up to something, are you?

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: Don't mention it. You are no longer the enemy of the Legion.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: Haha... You're the one who's up to no good. Did you just call the Bureau to have us arrested?

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: Give it a rest, Chief. We don't have to be at each other's throats anymore.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Then ask that man to be nicer to me.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: Earl?

options: He fixed a bomb on me.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: Hahaha... I'm not surprised.
You find it funny?

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: You can rest easy. The bomb goes dead automatically after 24 hours. He probably forgot to explain it to you.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: Horo is still unconscious. Her overprotective brother's mind is on nothing else at the moment.
...Horo? Earl is her brother?

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: Don't act so surprised in front of Horo. She would read it as "one sibling is so tall while the other is so short," and then get super mad.
Looks like there's a lot of juicy stuff going on in the Legion. But now there's something more important to ask.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: The contamination has been all cleared out, but she is still in a coma. The corruption by the inheritance is more serious than I thought.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: When she wakes up, we can find out how she got the intel about the inheritance.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: ...We have to ferret those guys out.

options: At least the misunderstanding has been cleared up.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: The MBCC now knows Horo has nothing to do with Suspect R, and that this Mania crisis also has nothing to do with the Sinners.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: We'll find out the force behind the inheritance. They are the culprit for the disasters in Syndicate.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: ...Someone said something along those lines to me before.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: He said Syndicate's misfortunes are the work of a clique of conspirators and evil elements. He's also looking for them.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: If we can get rid of them, the Syndicate will be free of chaos, and return to its former glory.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: He was like you, a naive misfit in the authorities.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: But he's dead now.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: He died while doing his investigation. Whether he got something or not, it doesn't matter now.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: I can't be bothered to picture how this place might change. Ever since I could remember, the Syndicate has always been chaotic and violent.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: Abandoned the city, then become a degenerate; or become a degenerate, then abandoned by the city... It makes no difference. It was once glorious, but that glory is long gone.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: Even if you find out the one behind the inheritance, the gangs will still fight to the bitter end for the inheritance's husk.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: This isn't a case of one worm turning the water murky, but a case of the murky water breeding millions of worms.

options: So destroying everything is the solution?

steps.content: You look into her eyes, a bit deeper, trying your best to ascertain... whether the cold fire of anger is still burning silently inside her.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: ...You have put the shackles on me, so you can stop me anytime you want unless I kill you, right?
She is setting your mind at ease, but at the same time, she has changed the subject. At this moment, the noises of a helicopter interrupt you.
It's the MBCC. They have arrived over one hour sooner than scheduled.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Chief, you're all right, thank goodness.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: ...Nice to meet you, Commander of the Legion, Sinner Zoya.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: Adjutant of ${PlayerName}, is it? Are these all the people you've brought?

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: The MBCC holds no grudge against the Legion, and for the time being, we are not after the Sinners on the loose, or you.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: This is our way of expressing our <color=#fb9259>gratitude</color>, by order of the Chief.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: Oh?

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: The MBCC has sorted out the Chief's oral account, and has submitted a preliminary operation report, in which we've clarified the source of the Mania crisis and emphasized the contribution of the Syndicate Sinners in the operation.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Just now, we received a request from the <color=#fb9259>Public Security Bureau of the DisCity</color>.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: They read the report, and are asking to get in touch with you to discuss the business of the inheritance and the amendment of <color=#fb9259>West District Order Management Regulations</color>.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: They came to you and made this request?

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Yes, the authorities wish to reopen the negotiation and discuss the future of the Syndicate with local representatives.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: And that's also what the Chief wants.
Zoya falls silent and turns to look at you.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: The reception must have been good. You got this big load of information across in such a short time?

options: I wish there were other ways around this.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: ...That sounds superior for a mere chief.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: There's no way I'm gonna give you the inheritance, but I want to see how sincere you are. You can go get the Public Security Bureau to send <color=#fb9259>someone suitable</color> to talk to me.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: I agree to participate in the negotiation, for the sake of the new MBCC chief.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: Are you satisfied with this arrangement, Chief ${PlayerName}?

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: Go, go back to your subordinates. We'll meet again.

steps.speaker: Earl
steps.content: Come out. The coast is clear.

steps.speaker: Blond Driver
steps.content: That was quite amicable. Doesn't your commander hate the guts of people from the authorities? I'm surprised she didn't tear apart that helicopter, tsk tsk.

steps.speaker: Earl
steps.content: She has her reasons.

steps.speaker: Blond Driver
steps.content: All right then. Please pay the information fees, Second-in-command of the Legion. Just swipe your card here.

steps.speaker: Blond Driver
steps.content: It took me quite some time to spy on them. This is a reasonable price, isn't it?

steps.speaker: Earl
steps.content: Of course it is. Speaking of which, you lost the <color=#fb9259>White Cube</color>, and a staff member.

steps.speaker: Earl
steps.content: That woman asked for such a low price... quite out of character.

steps.speaker: Blond Driver
steps.content: This is how the woman put it. "This is how the Cube is supposed to be used, instead of sitting in my place collecting dust. And one fewer mouth to feed, which means less expenditure for the company."

steps.speaker: Blond Driver
steps.content: And... "My good fella, please give us a good review, and we hope to be of your service again."

steps.speaker: Blond Driver
steps.content: I've checked the Chief out, he is trustworthy. <color=#fb9259>K.K.</color> is safer with him.
steps.female_content: I've checked the Chief out, she is trustworthy. <color=#fb9259>K.K.</color> is safer with her.

steps.speaker: Blond Driver
steps.content: One more thing, please tell your boss, "The <color=#fb9259>inheritance</color> is salvaged, and it's just the beginning."

steps.speaker: Blond Driver
steps.content: "Boss Bai sends her regards."

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: ...You still can't let the Suspect R thing go? Rest assured, no one can fault you on that.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: You got a lot to show for your first mission out. You achieved a lot for the Sinners, the FAC, and the DisCity.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: You can return to the Bureau first. I'm staying in the Syndicate until the negotiation is over.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: And when you get back, help me track down the source of that erroneous intel. I really want to know.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: How's Horo doing?

steps.speaker: Earl
steps.content: She is not getting worse, or better.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: Is that so? ...Sorry, Earl. I was late.

steps.speaker: Earl
steps.content: No need to apologize. She chose the path, and so did the Legion. We've decided to follow you. I hope you're not getting cold feet.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: ...Never.

steps.speaker: Earl
steps.content: Great. We're ready to tie up the loose ends of the crypt business.
Zoya nods, walks over to the edge of the cliff, ignites a lighter, and tosses it.
Boom—

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: Destroy every Mania weapon and Crystal, and take all the documents. Put them in a safe place along with Horo.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: This is the clue she risked her life for. Keep that in mind, and get to the bottom of all this.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: I need to make some preparations for the <color=#fb9259>negotiation</color>.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: Alright. Let's go.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: ...Let's go and change Syndicate.
